purpose: Nine winter publication candidates to avoid CET versus CEST ambiguity in pre-race feature availability. No Gold certification is asserted.
timezone_policy: Each qualifying release falls in European standard-time dates. Use literal CET UTC+1. PDF cover clocks have no timezone and are retained only as raw metadata.
source_policy: Official registry and PDF issue/publication claims observed today. Main audit owns byte retention, hashes and version-state verification; this file has no independently archived-byte claims.
feature_scope: Qualifying classification/time columns, full evidenced roster and team references, plus official scheduled race start and circuit identity. Optional weather/history/grid omitted.
cutoff_policy: Release minute plus120seconds. Compare every original/revised/recalled required-field document by its own availability; do not use later final qualifying as an early feature.

candidates.publication_timezone_basis: Literal CET is UTC+1; publication falls before European DST begins or after it ends, so ordinary Central European civil time also agrees.
candidates.cutoff_basis: Two minutes after printed publication minute, allowing that minute to finish. Main audit must verify all required-field documents available by cutoff.
candidates.completion_basis: This is a conservative bound from availability of a matching completed qualifying classification, not an observed session-end timestamp.
candidates.audit_status: Candidate only. Main audit must retain exact bytes, hashes, registry row binding and complete required-field state at cutoff.

outcome_parsing_policy.explicit_status: Keep explicit DNS, DNF and DQ. Missing rank or low lap count alone does not establish which status applies.
outcome_parsing_policy.classified_retirement: A classified numeric rank can still carry DNF; preserve both independently.
outcome_parsing_policy.unknown: Use unknown when a needed outcome status is absent and no other official evidence resolves it.
outcome_parsing_policy.labels_feature_separation: Final outcome documents and later amendments are labels only and cannot revise pre-cutoff features.
